scope: Exact original behavior is required. Similar functions are not proof of parity.
reusable_with_existing_frozen_comparison: PCM frame to inharmonicity: 11 saved WAVs and 132 partial diagnostics
IH interpolation and three-part curves: 190 configurations
Overpull correction from measured offsets: 1056 notes
Legacy automatic fitting and split-scale curve: 32 configurations

must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.prototype_difference: PianoLab uses a target-band FFT estimator with its own noise gate and capture threshold.

must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.original: PhaseDisplayV with original phase and quality values
must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.prototype_difference: PianoLab animates from frequency error; that is not the original demodulated phase.
PianoLab uses a harmonic-comb heuristic and its own frame hysteresis.
Range presets and manual partial selection do not reproduce the original adaptive selector.

must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.original: mparVelQual / mparAvgVelQual and partial weight tables
must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.prototype_difference: PianoLab merges partial cents using a median, which is not the original algorithm.
Original lock state, time constants and transition semantics have not been reproduced.
PianoLab uses its own logarithmic display instead of the original frequency and mid-zoom mappings.
Manual target-band premeasurements are not a complete port of the original predictive measurement chain.

must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.original: Exam / exam detune and report generation
must_port_original_implementation_or_dem.prototype_difference: PianoLab practice comparison omits the original exam state and report calculations.
Original saved cents, selected partials, extra fields and exam import semantics require exact preservation.
Manual and reference-tone correction do not include the original internet time calibration path.
